| Year | Winner | Served on Program Committee For |
|------|--------|----------------------------------|
| 2017 | Damien Fair | 2020 Flux Congress |
| 2018 | Leah Somerville | 2021 Flux Congress |
| 2019 | Eva Telzer | 2022 Flux Congress |
| 2020 | Dylan Gee | 2020 Flux Congress |
| 2021 | Kate Mills | 2022 Flux Congress |
| 2022 | Jennifer Silvers | **Did not serve** |
